subject: Pen test report and scope for procurement gate - Acme Corp
messages:
From: Jordan Lee <jordan.lee@acme.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@acme.com>, Acme SecOps <secops@acme.com>
Date: 2026-02-20T08:12:00-08:00
Subject: Pen test report & scope for procurement gate

Hi Marissa,

We need a copy of Redwood's most recent external penetration test report and a short summary of the testing scope, along with current remediation status. Our procurement team is gating the PO on this and needs the materials to complete security review by 2026-03-01.

A couple of specific questions from SecOps: does the report cover hosted API endpoints (api.redwood.com) and dedicated customer pools (Redwood Dedicated)? Are there any open high/critical findings, and if so, what are the planned remediation timelines?

Please advise if you need an NDA or a secure upload destination.

Thanks,
Jordan
Procurement Lead, Acme Corporation
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Lee <jordan.lee@acme.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-02-20T10:03:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Pen test report & scope for procurement gate

Hi Jordan — thanks for the note and the deadline heads-up. I can get you the executive summary and scope today.

Quick answers in brief: the most recent external pentest (Dec 2025) included our hosted API endpoints and the management plane for Dedicated; it did not include customer-managed on-prem packages. There are two medium findings and one low finding currently open; no high/critical findings. I will confirm timelines for remediation and share the report under an access-controlled Drive link.

Looping in Rishi (AE) and Laura (security) to confirm the evidence and upload method.

Best,
Marissa
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Jordan Lee <jordan.lee@acme.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-02-20T11:22:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Pen test report & scope for procurement gate

Hi Jordan / Marissa —

Confirmed: the December 2025 external penetration test was an external black-box assessment against our production-facing surface area. Scope included: api.redwood.com (public API endpoints), auth/login, web console (console.redwood.com), and the control plane endpoints that manage Dedicated instances. The assessment explicitly excluded customer-managed on-prem packages and VPC network configurations.

Summary of open findings (high-level):
- 0 high / critical
- 2 medium (one related to an edge-caching header configuration; one related to a stale dependency in an internal admin endpoint that is scheduled for remediation)
- 1 low (info disclosure in ancillary logging)

Remediation status: both medium findings are in remediation; expected closure dates: 2026-02-28 (edge header fix deployed 2026-02-26, validation in progress), and 2026-03-07 (dependency update blocker being tracked). I have attached the remediation tracker and will upload the signed pen-test report PDF to a secure Drive folder (link below) accessible to your SecOps group. If you need an encrypted delivery method, we can use our vendor portal or an SFTP drop.

Attachments: redwood-pen-test-report-2025.pdf (redacted summary), remediation-tracker-2026-02-28.csv

Laura Bennett
Security Lead, Redwood Inference
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Lee <jordan.lee@acme.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-02-24T09:45:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Pen test report & scope for procurement gate

Jordan — following up on Laura's summary. Procurement asked for confirmation that accepting the report will satisfy the security gate (MAP) required for issuing the PO, and whether any outstanding items would block signature. Per Laura: there are no open high/critical findings, and two medium items with remediation plans. Our security policy allows deals to proceed when there are no critical findings and medium findings have committed remediation timelines; we will add a clause to the SOW noting outstanding items and expected closure dates.

If Acme's procurement requires a hard 'no open findings' policy, let me know and we'll escalate to get additional compensating controls documented. Otherwise, can we get procurement to accept the report + remediation SLA clause and proceed to finalize the PO? The procurement deadline you mentioned is 2026-03-01 — short window, so appreciate a quick confirmation.

—Rishi
Director, Sales | Redwood Inference
From: Jordan Lee <jordan.lee@acme.com>
